'''Jerne''' was a spoken and [[Writing/Legends|written]] [[language]]<ref name="Gamer 9" /> that shared its name with the [[planet]] [[Jerne]].<ref name="Dark Knight's Devilry">{{StoryCite|story=Dark Knight's Devilry|book=The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 153}}</ref> The [[Xenoarchaeology/Legends|xenoarchaeologist]] [[Follnor Callat]] could speak and write it.<ref name="Gamer 9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jerne was mentioned in the article "[[Race for the Tessent]]," authored by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[Daniel Wallace]], and [[Jason Fry]] and published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine.<ref name="Gamer 9" /> The issue was published on [[February 22]], [[2002]].<ref name="GamerDate">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020222.html|text=Starfighters Soar in Gamer #9}}</ref>
